name: Asia Metal Industries, Inc.
summary: Established in 1973 and headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, Asia Metal Industries, Inc. is a prominent manufacturer and supplier of specialized coating machinery. The company serves a global clientele, with its products reaching markets throughout Asia, the Americas, and Europe. Its extensive portfolio comprises equipment tailored for various applications, including the production of synthetic paper, solar energy components, optical devices, high-frequency and flexible copper clad laminates (CCL), passive electronic parts, batteries, carbon fiber materials, industrial tapes, and transparent conductive films. In addition to its manufacturing activities, the firm delivers comprehensive engineering solutions, offering services such as initial consultations, post-sale support, technical guidance, R&D testing, and facility planning.
